scope: Compare the four GTK2 normal arrow glyphs and 15x15 stepper cells against corresponding pixels in the native Domain/OS SR10.4 HP VUE 2.01 Trash Can capture.

reference.coordinate_basis: Global positions from TRASH-CAN-METRICAS.json; horizontal end cells are the 15px endpoints of the measured 539x15 horizontal bar, with glyphs centered at a 2px inset. Crop origin in the full desktop image is (88,342).

inputs.palette_note: The compared theme assets are the DomainOS scheme rendering. R578 independently verifies that all 20 arrow assets are regenerated from KDE roles and change across three real .colors schemas; this receipt covers the DomainOS-colored normal raster only.

method.comparison: Decode source RGB and asset RGBA. Compare RGB for every fully opaque asset pixel at the corresponding measured source coordinate; no resize, interpolation, or color conversion beyond RGBA-to-RGB channel selection.

arrows.per_direction: 71/71 opaque RGB pixels identical in the 11x11 glyph

stepper_cells.per_direction: 225/225 RGB pixels identical in the 15x15 cell

limits: This is an image-to-asset comparison of the normal state, not a live GTK2 widget capture or evidence of GTK2 event delivery.
It does not cover pressed, hover, disabled, selection, or scroll-thumb states; R557 remains the historical pressed-state evidence for the down glyph only.
A pixel match to the empty Trash Can does not establish spacing, behavior, or appearance in the user's specific GTK2 application.

reconciliation.R496_R553: The normal horizontal bar/cell geometry remains exact in earlier measurements.
reconciliation.R557: Down glyph normal/pressed/release historical pixels remain exact; this receipt extends normal-state coverage to up/left/right and full stepper cells.
reconciliation.changes_record: The R576/R577 test-only source change is separately registered and content-verified as R579.
